name: cart_update
description: The cart changed. One event with a discriminator (action = add or remove) instead of two event types; every push carries the whole cart in the state lists.
purpose: Abandoned cart and cart value segments.
page: Any page with an add-to-cart or remove button, and the cart page
trigger: The shopper clicks add to cart or remove, after the cart is updated.

properties.name: action
properties.description: Whether the shopper adds an item to the cart or removes it. Decides the cart_update variant.

properties.name: product_id
properties.description: Catalog id of the product (the main catalog item_id).

properties.name: variant_id
properties.description: Catalog id of the size or colour variant.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Product name as shown in the shop.

properties.name: quantity
properties.description: Number of units of the item.

properties.name: product_ids
properties.description: Ids of every product in the cart or order after this event.

properties.name: product_list
properties.description: Every item in the cart or order after this event, with unit price and quantity.

properties.name: total_price
properties.description: Sum of price times quantity over the item list.

properties.name: total_quantity
properties.description: Sum of quantity over the item list.

properties.name: currency
properties.description: ISO 4217 currency of every price in the event.

triggers.title: Add to cart on the product page
triggers.description: Click on the Add to cart button; the push happens once the mini-cart has updated.

rules.name: cart_update_total_price_sum
rules.message: "total_price" must equal the sum of product_list[].price * quantity.

rules.name: cart_update_total_quantity_sum
rules.message: "total_quantity" must equal the sum of product_list[].quantity.

findings.message: State lists for "product_id" disagree in length: product_ids has 2, product_list has 1.
After action "add", product_id "P-2002" is missing from product_list.
